pages.text: The $(bold)Curse Vault$() is a curse power storehouse you can place in the world.$(br2)$(li)Placing it $(bold)binds the placer as its user$()$(li)Capacity $(bold)100,000 (100k)$() curse power, 20 times the bottle$(li)$(bold)Indestructible$(): bedrock-level hardness, blast proof, pistons cannot move it$(br2)Restore priority is: $(l:bottle)bottle$() then $(bold)vault$() then the curse core (temporary storage).

$(bold)Retrieving$(): the user can $(bold)left-click with an empty hand$() (or sneak + empty hand + right-click) to pick the vault back up, $(bold)keeping all stored curse power$() (shown on the item durability bar).$(br2)Other players cannot take it; they only get a message that it belongs to someone else.

$(bold)Ways to use it$():$(li)empty-hand left-click / sneak right-click: pick up$(li)empty-hand right-click: report stored amount$(li)right-click holding a $(bold)container with Curse Residue$(): pour it in (1 mb = 10 curse)$(li)right-click holding an $(bold)empty container$(): draw residue back out$(br2)$(bold)Look at the vault$() with your crosshair and the stored curse power plus a capacity bar appear right below the crosshair (above 10,000 it is shown in k/wan notation, e.g. 1.2w).

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: The $(bold)Curse Vault$() is made by the $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() (JEI shows the same recipe):$(br2)$(bold)Core slot$() (the lantern right above the ore) takes:$(li)1 x The Call of R'lyeh$(br2)$(bold)Material slots$() (the other 8 lanterns) take:$(li)1 x Obsidian$(li)1 x Prison Realm Gate$(li)4 x Boundary Fragment$(li)2 x Seared Brick$(br2)$(bold)Curse cost$(): $(bold)3000$() (the ritual drains 10 per tick, about 15 seconds)$(br2)Note: the material count must be $(bold)exact$() (here exactly 8 items) - one extra item means no match and the ritual will not start. See $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() for how to build the structure.

pages.title: Core: The Call of R'lyeh
pages.text: Put the $(bold)core item$() on the lantern right above the ore (right-click), place the materials on the eight material lanterns, then $(bold)hold the core and right-click the core lantern$() to start.$(br2)The product floats above the core lantern afterwards; right-click to take it.
